description: Postmark for an agent: search sent and received email, bounces, suppressions, templates and stats on one server; send an email or a template email to one recipient, reactivate a bounced address, and suppress or unsuppress an address, with every write governed.

secrets.name: POSTMARK
secrets.description: The connected Postmark Server API token

actions.name: list-message-streams
actions.description: List the server's message streams that are not archived: id, name, type (Transactional, Broadcasts, Inbound) and unsubscribe handling. Use a stream's id as message_stream in the other actions. A server has few streams, so they come in one response.

type.description: Filter to streams of this type. All when absent.

actions.name: search-outbound-messages
actions.description: Search sent and queued emails: message id, recipients, from, subject, tag, status, metadata and stream, without bodies (use get-outbound-message). 20 a page. Messages are kept for the server's retention period, 45 days unless changed in Postmark.

offset.description: How many results to skip. 0 to start; add 20 for each next page. offset plus 20 may not pass 10000.

recipient.description: Filter to emails sent to this address.

from_email.description: Filter to emails sent from this address.

tag.description: Filter to emails with this tag.

status.description: Filter to queued, or to sent, emails.

subject.description: Filter to emails with this subject.

message_stream.description: Filter to emails in this stream. Postmark searches the outbound stream when absent.

fromdate.description: Filter to results from this date or time, inclusive, in US Eastern time: 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

todate.description: Filter to results up to this date or time, inclusive, in US Eastern time.

actions.name: get-outbound-message
actions.description: Get one sent email by message id: recipients, from, subject, text and HTML bodies, tag, metadata, status, and its events (Delivered, Bounced, Opened, LinkClicked, Transient, SubscriptionChanged) with their times. A long body can be cut at the response limit.

message_id.description: The MessageID a send returned, or one from search-outbound-messages.

actions.name: search-inbound-messages
actions.description: Search emails the server received: message id, from, to, subject, mailbox hash, attachments' names and sizes, and status. 20 a page. Postmark returns processed messages unless status is given.

offset.description: How many results to skip. 0 to start; add 20 for each next page. offset plus 20 may not pass 10000.

recipient.description: Filter to emails received at this address.

from_email.description: Filter to emails from this address.

subject.description: Filter to emails with this subject.

mailbox_hash.description: Filter to emails sent to this mailbox hash (the part after + in the inbound address).

status.description: Filter to emails with this status. processed when absent.

fromdate.description: Filter to results from this date or time, inclusive, in US Eastern time: 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

todate.description: Filter to results up to this date or time, inclusive, in US Eastern time.

actions.name: get-inbound-message
actions.description: Get one received email by message id: from, to, cc, reply-to, subject, date, text and HTML bodies, headers, attachments' names, status and, if it was blocked, why. A long body can be cut at the response limit.

actions.name: list-bounces
actions.description: List bounces: bounce id, type (HardBounce, SoftBounce, Transient and others), the address, the message id, when, and whether Postmark deactivated the address and it can be reactivated (Inactive, CanActivate). 20 a page.

offset.description: How many results to skip. 0 to start; add 20 for each next page. offset plus 20 may not pass 10000.

type.description: Filter to bounces of this type, for example HardBounce, SoftBounce or Transient.

inactive.description: true for bounces that deactivated their address, false for the rest. Both when absent.

email.description: Filter to bounces for this address.

tag.description: Filter to bounces of emails with this tag.

message_id.description: Filter to the bounces of this message.

message_stream.description: Filter to bounces in this stream. Postmark uses the outbound stream when absent.

fromdate.description: Filter to results from this date or time, inclusive, in US Eastern time: 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

todate.description: Filter to results up to this date or time, inclusive, in US Eastern time.

actions.name: get-bounce
actions.description: Get one bounce by id: type, description, details, the address, the message id, when, whether the address is inactive and can be reactivated, and the bounce content. Long content can be cut at the response limit.

actions.name: get-delivery-stats
actions.description: Get the server's bounce totals by type, and how many addresses are inactive because of a bounce or a complaint. Changes nothing.

actions.name: get-outbound-stats
actions.description: Get the server's sending totals: sent, bounced, bounce rate, spam complaints, opens, unique opens and clicks, for all time or a date range, optionally for one tag or stream. Dates are US Eastern time.

tag.description: Filter to emails with this tag.

message_stream.description: Filter to this stream. Every stream when absent.

actions.name: list-suppressions
actions.description: List the addresses a stream will not send to, with the reason (HardBounce, SpamComplaint, ManualSuppression), the origin (Recipient, Customer, Admin) and when. Postmark returns every match in one response, so give an address or a date range on a large list: a response over the limit is cut.

message_stream.description: A message stream id from list-message-streams, for example outbound (the default transactional stream) or broadcast.

reason.description: Filter to suppressions for this reason.

origin.description: Filter to suppressions added this way.

actions.name: list-templates
actions.description: List the server's templates: id, name, alias, whether it is active, and its type (Standard or Layout). 20 a page. Use an id or alias in get-template or send-template-email.

offset.description: How many templates to skip. 0 to start; add 20 for each next page.

type.description: Filter to templates of this type. All when absent.

actions.name: get-template
actions.description: Get one template by id or alias: name, subject, HTML and text bodies with their placeholders, whether it is active, and its layout. Read it before send-template-email to know which values template_model needs.

template.description: A template id (digits) or alias from list-templates.

actions.name: send-email
actions.description: Send one email to one recipient from a confirmed sender signature or domain, in a message stream. Give text_body, html_body or both. Returns the MessageID. Read back by MessageID from the stream's activity; the subject must match. Limitations: one To address and no Cc, Bcc or attachments, so each call is one email; there is no idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can send it twice; an address Postmark marked inactive is refused.

from.description: The sender: an address on a confirmed sender signature or domain, alone or as "Full Name <sender@example.com>".

text_body.description: The plain-text body. Give this, html_body, or both.

reply_to.description: Where replies go. The sender signature's reply-to when absent.

tag.description: A tag to group the email in Postmark's statistics.

message_stream.description: The stream to send in: outbound for transactional email, or a broadcast stream id from list-message-streams.

actions.name: send-template-email
actions.description: Send one email to one recipient from a server template, filled with template_model. Give template_id or template_alias. Returns the MessageID. Read back by MessageID from the stream's activity; the stream must match. Limitations: one To address and no Cc, Bcc or attachments; the subject and bodies come from the template, so they are not checked; no idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can send it twice.

template_id.description: The template's id from list-templates. Give this or template_alias.

template_model.description: The values the template's placeholders use, by name: {"name": "Ada", "product_name": "Pro"}. get-template shows the placeholders.

from.description: The sender: an address on a confirmed sender signature or domain, alone or as "Full Name <sender@example.com>".

tag.description: A tag to group the email in Postmark's statistics.

message_stream.description: The stream to send in: outbound for transactional email, or a broadcast stream id.

actions.name: activate-bounce
actions.description: Reactivate an address Postmark deactivated after a bounce, so email to it is sent again. A bounce can be reactivated when its CanActivate is true. Read back from the bounce; Inactive must be false. Limitation: a hard bounce usually means the address does not exist, and sending to it again can hurt the server's reputation.

bounce_id.description: A bounce ID from list-bounces with Inactive and CanActivate true.

actions.name: suppress-recipient
actions.description: Stop a stream from sending to one address (a manual suppression). Email to it is then refused until the suppression is removed. Read back from the stream's suppressions; the address must be among them. Postmark answers 200 when it could not suppress an address, so the read-back is what shows it worked.

message_stream.description: A message stream id from list-message-streams, for example outbound (the default transactional stream) or broadcast.

email.description: The address to suppress, in lower case as Postmark lists it.

actions.name: unsuppress-recipient
actions.description: Remove one address from a stream's suppressions, so email to it is sent again. A suppression for a spam complaint cannot be removed. Read back from the stream's suppressions; the address must be gone. Postmark answers 200 when it could not remove an address, so the read-back is what shows it worked. Limitation: the person may have asked not to be emailed.

message_stream.description: A message stream id from list-message-streams, for example outbound (the default transactional stream) or broadcast.

email.description: The suppressed address, in lower case as list-suppressions shows it.

policies.name: postmark: approve sending a template email
postmark: approve reactivating a bounced address

limits.name: postmark: template emails sent per day
postmark: bounced addresses reactivated per day
